name: cf-cdn-tf-domain
description: Generates all Terraform configuration files for a single domain's CloudFront distribution under terraform/domains/{hostname}/. Reads ir/final/{hostname}.yaml and shared/dedup_manifest.json to emit: main.tf (module call to cloudfront_distribution with all origins, cache behaviors, and viewer certificate settings), variables.tf (domain-specific input variables with defaults from the IR), outputs.tf (distribution ID, ARN, domain name for DNS CNAME setup), and optionally functions/{name}.js (domain-specific CloudFront Function source files if not already in shared). Handles ACM certificate ARN injection, price class selection, IPv6 toggle, and HTTP/2+3 settings. Must be invoked once per domain (parallelizable). Accepts a --domain argument.
